route_title: 28-Layer Expanded Chirped Stack with Increased Design Degrees of Freedom
compilation_rationale: Bounded route overrides 28-layer design to exactly six HfO2/SiO2 pairs (12 finite layers) on fused silica. Objectives map to maximizing mean transmittance in 1530–1565 nm and mean reflectance in 400–700 nm. All twelve thicknesses are optimized independently within 30–120 nm bounds using a gradient-based solver.
